fields.v: Automatic capture via local HTTP server intercepting the first request to the main model, in fresh containers; automatic segmentation and diffs. Coding: GLM 5.3 Flash (via OpenRouter) validated against two human coders (human kappa 0.75; LLM 93.4% agreement, kappa 0.92). Tracing: mini-swe-agent with Gemini 4 Argon, validated on 55 transitions (795/798 links correct); motivation coding by Gemini 4 Argon, kappa >= 0.82 vs reference

fields.v: Relevant to SDD only indirectly: argues the agent release is an experimental variable and that repository guidance (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) operates inside the instruction stack. Reporting inconsistency: 25 of 1,911 releases not captured, but the text explains only 22 (15 OpenCode provider failures + 7 broken packages, p. 5); Table I gives 23 OpenCode, 1 Claude Code, 1 Codex missing. Fig. 3 table values partly jumbled by pdftotext (latest-release column); medians in text used. Replication package (anonymous 4open.science link) [1]. Codex switched from TypeScript to Rust implementation. No pre-registration
